{{Quote|What's it like on Kessel? Is it really ''that'' bad?|Shaull explorer|<ref name="Star Wars Gamemaster Screen, Revised">''[[Star Wars Gamemaster Screen, Revised]]''</ref>}}
The '''Shaull''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that hailed from an unidentified [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. They possessed light-[[Color/Legends|colored]] skin with patches of darker color on the wrist, forearm, and elbows. Shaull were [[Hair/Legends|hairless]], but possessed a form of cilia-like growth on the backs of their heads, shoulders, and back. Their faces were very smooth and flat, without visible [[Nose/Legends|nostrils]].

Few Shaull explored the [[Star/Legends|stars]], and those who did often started out as [[Slavery/Legends|indentured servants]] on more advanced [[Starship/Legends|ships]]. The species adapted well to [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]]-standard technology and often possessed a combination of archaic and modern skills amongst those encountered in the space lanes.

Some Shaull were known for their curiosity and love of new and unexplored places. Many simply wished to experience everything and see all things.
